comments.author: shenghanzhe
comments.body_html: I researched Realism’s implementation, but because it’s an overhaul mod, it modifies input at a level where it touches a lot of BSG’s interconnected systems. So I built this mod for myself in 3.11 on top of hazelify’s VCO mod, which overwrites the camera output. I used his technique but added hands rotation / position as well. This way it would be less invasive on the game engine (rather than modifying the input values that BSG uses for sway, ergo, recoil etc.). Since I finished my SPT playthrough, I decided to update to 4.0 and release.
